instruments.notes: Marketing derivative - long-term contract to purchase and simultaneously sell oil at Midland terminal. 50,000 Bbls/day Jan 2021 - Dec 2026. Purchase price indexed to Midland WTI, sale price is WASP correlated with Brent. Price is variable - source does not specify a fixed price for this floating-price marketing contract. Verified: source discloses volumes but not per-unit prices for this position.
